message: No detected input validation: The CSV file is loaded directly with pd.read_csv without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local file path with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: The code loads a CSV and trains a LinearRegression model without any checks on label distributions, validation of label values, or label-noise detection tools.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to the dataset before use in the pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates a LinearRegression model directly from sklearn without loading any serialized weights, and no hash/signature verification or controlled-source loading is implemented.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks label distribution, class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms are present; the training simply uses sklearn's LinearRegression without any anomaly or activation-pattern analysis.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although multiple metrics (MSE, MAE, R2) are imported, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other metric-tampering protections; the data split strategy is not visible in the truncated code.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are visible in the inference data-flow path before data is passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, sanity bounds, or output validation checks are present on the model's predictions before they are returned or visualized.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a scikit-learn LinearRegression (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
